sections.title: Fixed
items: DualSense Share and PS buttons no longer stop responding after the first press. A held button could get stuck internally when two input paths reported the same press, which then silently swallowed every following press. Each physical press now runs as one owned press cycle, so repeated Share/PS taps keep working.

sections.title: Notes
items: This is a focused hotfix on top of 0.7.4; the HDR capture improvements from 0.7.4 are unchanged.
Individual controller-model compatibility remains unverified until confirmed on the relevant hardware.
